name: opensprachfuchs-worker
description: Cloudflare Worker for OpenSprachFuchs: accounts, encrypted saves, friends and language packs

scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler deploy && wrangler deploy --name opensprachfuchs
scripts.//deploy: Deploys the worker as app (app.<subdomain>.workers.dev) and under its old name opensprachfuchs, which app versions up to 0.0.14 and older friend links still use. Forks can drop the second deploy.
